[SWS_SwCluC_CONSTR_02145] Application Software Cluster’s NvBlocks
are treated as ’resistant to changed SW’ by NvM in Host Software Cluster
Upstream requirements: SRS_SwCluC_00206, SRS_BSW_00167
⌈For any NVRAM Block belonging to an Application Software Cluster (NvM
Low Proxy of the SwCluC occurs as block user) the parameter NvMResistant-
ToChangedSw shall be set to TRUE in the Host Software Cluster.⌋
Note: This includes the NVRAM Blocks used to store the configuration ID of a specific
Application Software Cluster
In addition, the NvBlocks in the Host Software Cluster have to be configured
such, that the Configuration ID block of an Application Software Clus-
ter is restored before the regular NvBlocks of that Application Software Clus-
ter. Since the NvM ensures the processing order of NvM Blocks during a NvM_-
ReadAll job by the Block Id ([SWS_NvM_00244]). This enables that the NvM High
Proxy can process its Config Block ID handling before that recovery of the regular
NvBlocks.
